    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersBook tour canapésSmoked salmon crème fraîche blinis and rockmelon wrapped in prosciuttoHow to make it16 blinis200ml crème fraîche200g smoked salmon2 tbsp snipped chives1/2 rockmelon100g prosciuttoTop the blinis with crème fraîche, a fold of smoked salmon and chives.Cut the rockmelon into neat wedges, remove the skin and wrap each with a thin slice of prosciutto.Lay both out on trays in rows.Cover model coconut prawnsCoconut and panko crusted prawns fried golden, with sweet chilli sauceHow to make it500g green prawns, peeled, tails on2 eggs, beaten1 cup shredded coconut1 cup panko breadcrumbs1 L vegetable oil4 tbsp sweet chilli saucePeel the prawns, leaving the tails on.Dip each in beaten egg, then press into the mixed coconut and panko.Fry in the oil at 180°C for 2 minutes until golden and crisp, in batches. Serve with the sweet chilli sauce.Chilli lime jungle fruit cupsThe jungle on the remote islandHow to make itAs written, serves 4Mango, papaya, pineapple and passionfruit cut into cups, squeezed with lime and sprinkled with a chilli and sea salt dust.Peel and cut 2 mangoes, half a papaya and half a pineapple into long batons.Stand them up in 4 cups.Grind 1 tsp chilli flakes with 1 tsp sea salt and 1 tsp caster sugar.Squeeze the juice of 2 limes over the fruit, spoon the pulp of 2 passionfruit on top and sprinkle with the chilli salt just before serving.MainsIsland grilled fishLime chilli snapper grilled in banana leaf, with coconut rice and black beansHow to make it4 snapper fillets3 limes, juiced3 garlic cloves, crushed1 red chilli, chopped1 tsp salt4 banana leaves, softened300g long grain rice400ml coconut milk400g black beans, drainedRub the snapper with the lime juice, garlic, chilli and salt. Wrap each in a softened banana leaf.Grill for 10 minutes.Cook the rice in the coconut milk with a pinch of salt. Warm the black beans.Serve the fish in its leaf.Fairfax's eye fillet with béarnaiseFairfax, the spoilt billionaire who kidnaps LorettaHow to make itAs written, serves 4Beef eye fillet roasted pink and sliced thick, with a rich tarragon béarnaise, crispy smashed potatoes and grilled asparagus.Boil 1kg baby potatoes 15 minutes, smash flat, drizzle with oil and roast at 220°C for 35 minutes.Sear a seasoned 1kg eye fillet and roast at 220°C for 20 minutes, then rest.Reduce 60ml white wine vinegar with a chopped eschalot to 1 tbsp.Whisk 3 egg yolks with the reduction over simmering water until thick, then slowly whisk in 180g melted butter and add chopped tarragon.Grill 2 bunches asparagus.SweetsCrown of fire mango sorbetHomemade mango lime sorbet, scraped and frozen, scooped into glassesHow to make it150g caster sugar150ml hot water3 ripe mangoes2 limes, juiced3 passionfruitsDissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool.Blend the mango flesh with the syrup and lime juice until smooth.Freeze in a tray, scraping with a fork every hour for 4 hours.Scoop into glasses and top with passionfruit pulp.DrinksJungle escape coolerCoconut water, pineapple juice, mint and lime over ice, no alcoholHow to make it1 L coconut water1 L pineapple juice2 limes, cut into wedges1 handful mint leaves1 bag iceFill tall glasses with ice and a few mint leaves.Pour in equal parts coconut water and pineapple juice, squeeze in a lime wedge and stir well.
